title: Asian Markets Rise as Gold Miners Lift ASX 200 by 0.82%
summary: Asian markets rose as gold miners lifted the ASX 200 0.82%, a day after Australian inflation hit 4.9%. The yen held near 159 and Vanke sought a bond delay.
body_markdown:
The ABS release shows the last three readings beside the trimmed mean economists expected, per ABC News:

## What Does 4.9% Inflation Mean for the RBA?


It leaves the Reserve Bank of Australia (RBA) facing headline inflation, underlying inflation and unemployment that are all above where it forecast them for the end of 2026, according to ABC News. "Rising inflation and unemployment are the RBA's worst nightmare," said Harry Murphy Cruise, head of economic research at Oxford Economics, which still expects rates to stay on hold in December and through 2027.


## When Is the Next RBA Meeting?


The RBA board is due to hand down its next interest rate decision on December 8, ABC News reported. The ABS will release November CPI data on January 6, 2027.


## Yen Holds Near 159 Per Dollar


"The dollar flatlined on the yen at 159.15, with the risk of intervention keeping 160.00 resistance intact," Reuters reported on Thursday. As Tokyo trading closed, USD/JPY was up 0.03% at 159.21, according to Investing.com.


## Vanke Seeks 3-Year Delay on 1.2 Billion Yuan Bond


China Vanke, once the country's largest homebuilder, is seeking to push back a 1.2 billion yuan ($180 million) principal payment due December 15 by three years, while still paying the 3% coupon on time, according to[Bloomberg](https://longbridge.com/en/news/306876593) , citing people familiar with the matter. Vanke may share the proposal with more bondholders as early as Friday (Nov 27).


The developer posted a net loss of 8.99 billion yuan in the three months ended in September, and its contracted sales fell 48.3% from a year earlier, Bloomberg reported. Its US dollar bond due November 2029 fell 3.5 cents to 43.3 cents on the dollar on Wednesday, the lowest since late July.


## S&P 500 Futures Rise 0.7% as Nvidia Stays in Focus


With[US markets shut for Thanksgiving](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/news/us-markets-closed-friday-ends-early/) , S&P 500 futures, which follow the same index as the[SPDR S&P 500 ETF Trust (SPY)](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/us-stock/spy/) , added 0.7% and Nasdaq futures rallied 1.1%, according to Reuters. Reuters reported that new US tariff proposals on 14 trading partners, including China and Japan, were not as dire as feared and are unlikely to be imposed until February or March.


Nvidia remained a concern after ratings agency S&P put the chipmaker's credit rating on watch for a possible downgrade, citing weaknesses in its management and board, Reuters reported.[Nvidia (NVDA)](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/us-stock/nvda/)[ended down 3.9% at $149.30](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/news/nvidia-nvda-stock-news-november-26-2026/) on Wednesday (Nov 25).
